card.name: Hedging words before "fatal"
card.fires_on: Small linking or hedging words right after "serious" or "life-threatening" that come just before the word "fatal", such as "even", "possibly", "potentially", "sometimes", "or", "including".

modes.label: Even before fatal
modes.description: The word "even" after "serious or" leads into "fatal" in warnings about infections in immunosuppressed patients.

modes.label: Hedge after serious and
modes.description: A hedging adverb after "serious and" leads into "fatal" in warnings about interactions or organ injury.
modes.example: the risk of serious and<< potentially>> fatal liver injury. ( 2.

modes.description: A plain joining word such as "or" or "including" sits between a severity term and "fatal".
